text:
mia-support: Hey team — Quillix onboarding is stuck. Console shows an API key was created but their app gets 403s when hitting /v1/generate. Can someone triage?
quinn-cs: Customer reported this 30m ago, they tried repro with curl and get a 403. They need this for an early access demo tomorrow.
alex-eng: Can you paste the curl and response? Also which project_id did the console show?
quinn-cs: curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
Response body: `{"error":"forbidden","message":"API key not authorized for project: quillix-prod"}`
quinn-cs: Console shows key created under project "internal-service-ops" (weird) — the UI dropdown during provisioning said Quillix / quillix-prod though.
rachel-infra: That matches a known race: provisioner sometimes uses the wrong tenant when a background job picks up the claim too early. I can check the audit trail.
rachel-infra: @devops-bot audit log for key sk-REDACTED
devops-bot: Audit event: key.created id=key_01H8abcde created_by=provisioner service_account=provisioner@platform internal_project=internal-service-ops requested_project=quillix-prod claim_id=claim_772 ts=2026-02-12T20:12:03Z
rachel-infra: Looks like the key was indeed created and bound to internal-service-ops, but the claim requested quillix-prod. Provisioner didn't finish the bind step.
alex-eng: Quick mitigation options: 1) rebind the existing key to quillix-prod (fast) 2) revoke and create a fresh key scoped to quillix-prod (safer)
quinn-cs: Customer prefers minimal change — they just want it working for the demo.
mia-support: Any security concerns with rebind?
rachel-infra: Rebind is fine for now. We'll run idempotent check to ensure no perms leak. Command I can run: ```redwoodctl keys rebind --key key_01H8abcde --project quillix-prod --actor rachel-infra```
rachel-infra: Doing the rebind now, will post logs.
oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0212-01 affected=provisioner key=key_01H8abcde owner=rachel-infra priority=high
rachel-infra: Rebind completed. Audit: key.rebind id=evt_9a8b ts=2026-02-12T20:22:11Z old_project=internal-service-ops new_project=quillix-prod actor=rachel-infra
quinn-cs: Told customer to retry. They report success 🎉 — requests now return 200 and model output.
mia-support: Great. Action items: rachel to open a prov bug and add retry/backoff on bind step; eng to add a dashboard for provisioning failures; cs to follow up with Quillix post-demo.
rachel-infra: Filed bug RDW-1198: provisioner claim-bind race, added triage notes and a small patch to the worker to validate project identity before finalizing key creation.
alex-eng: Thanks — please add the repro steps I posted to the issue: 1) create claim, 2) kill worker mid-bind, 3) let another worker pick it up and finish bind to wrong project.
quinn-cs: Logged customer impact and ETA in the CRM. Customer very appreciative of the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
mia-support: Closing thread — marking as resolved after patch lands in staging.
